title: From Dirac surface response to Casimir forces in Bumblebee-CFJ electrodynamics
summary: We examine the Casimir interaction between planar massive Dirac materials coupled to a Lorentz-violating Bumblebee-CFJ vector sector. The standard renormalized one-loop polarization tensor of the Dirac quasiparticles is used as the nonlocal surface response in the Lifshitz scattering formalism. For the normally oriented Lorentz-violating background, the surface response remains parity-even. Hence, the repulsive regimes do not originate from a Hall-like conductivity.
